plain: Choosing which facts sit in a user's memory, for example adding more that should not be shared, to see how a model copes.
eli5: Putting more and more secrets in the backpack and checking whether more of them fall out.
technical: CIMemories' first evaluation knob: control how many attributes are in memory and which are necessary or inappropriate for each task; with necessary attributes held fixed and inappropriate ones added (GPT-5, 5 profiles, Fig 5), violations rise steadily while completeness stays flat.
